# `/workgroups` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /workgroups/v1

`listWorkgroupsV1` — List governance groups

This API returns list of Governance Groups

- Scopes: idn:workgroup:manage, idn:workgroup:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, in, sw; name: eq, sw, in; memberships.identityId: eq, in — e.g. `name sw "Test"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: name, created, modified, id, description — e.g. `name,-modified`
- Returns 200: array of workgroupdto

### POST /workgroups/v1

`createWorkgroupV1` — Create a new governance group.

This API creates a new Governance Group.

- Scopes: idn:workgroup:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): workgroupdto
- Returns 200: workgroupdto

### GET /workgroups/v1/{id}

`getWorkgroupV1` — Get governance group by id

This API returns a Governance Groups by its ID.

- Scopes: idn:workgroup:manage, idn:workgroup:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the Governance Group
- Returns 200: workgroupdto

### DELETE /workgroups/v1/{id}

`deleteWorkgroupV1` — Delete a governance group

This API deletes a Governance Group by its ID.

- Scopes: idn:workgroup:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the Governance Group
- Returns 204: no body

### PATCH /workgroups/v1/{id}

`patchWorkgroupV1` — Patch a governance group

This API updates an existing governance group by ID. The following fields and objects are patchable: * name * description * owner

- Scopes: idn:workgroup:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the Governance Group
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: workgroupdto

- Scopes: idn:workgroup:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN

### POST /workgroups/v1/{workgroupId}/members/bulk-add

`updateWorkgroupMembersV1` — Add members to governance group

This API adds one or more members to a Governance Group. A token with API, ORG_ADMIN authority is required to call this API. > **Following field of Identity is an optional field in the request.** > **name**

- Scopes: idn:workgroup:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `workgroupId` (path, required) — ID of the Governance Group.
- Body (application/json): array of object

### POST /workgroups/v1/{workgroupId}/members/bulk-delete

`deleteWorkgroupMembersV1` — Remove members from governance group

This API removes one or more members from a Governance Group. A > **Following field of Identity is an optional field in the request.** > **name**

- Scopes: idn:workgroup:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `workgroupId` (path, required) — ID of the Governance Group.
- Body (application/json): array of object
